blockingFindings.title: R8 no-op AI bypass assertion
blockingFindings.rationale: R8 explicitly requires advancing from finalized checkpoint evidence without invoking review AI; the current test has a static anti-pattern that passes without exercising that production behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: The `AgentInvocationProbe` is never passed into or connected to any production replay/review path. `replay()` only snapshots `agentProbe.calls`, calls the local recorder, and parses hard-coded command output, so the assertions that review AI was not invoked would pass even if production replay invoked review AI.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Route the R8 scenario through the production checkpoint/replay path with an injected/stubbed review runner or agent hook, and assert that hook is not called.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R8 explicitly requires advancing from finalized checkpoint evidence without invoking review AI; the current test has a static anti-pattern that passes without exercising that production behavior.

blockingFindings.title: R8 triage transition is hard-coded
blockingFindings.rationale: R8 requires the raw fixture to pass through producer normalization and advance to triage; the current test does not cover the production behavior and can pass on a fabricated transition.
blockingFindings.issue: The test obtains `next` by calling `parseProposalReviewOutput` on a hard-coded stdout string rather than exercising the producer/replay code that should decide to advance to `draft-questions-triage`. This would pass even if the production transition never advanced to triage.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Exercise the production replay/producer transition that consumes the recorded repair-target artifact and assert its actual next phase is `draft-questions-triage`.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R8 requires the raw fixture to pass through producer normalization and advance to triage; the current test does not cover the production behavior and can pass on a fabricated transition.
